audit804_auto_evidence_cache.public_title: Anti Dandruff Hair Mist | Aijaz Aslam 100ml
audit804_auto_evidence_cache.description:
Lightweight Scalp Refresh for Flake Control and Shine
Anti Dandruff Hair Mist | Aijaz Aslam 100ml is designed to revitalize hair while supporting a balanced, refreshed scalp. This airy mist helps manage visible flakes and dryness without weighing strands down. Infused with Organic Argan Oil and Coconut Oil, the formula helps improve softness, smoothness, and natural shine while enhancing hair texture for styling. Suitable for all hair types, it delivers targeted scalp hydration and leaves hair looking polished and manageable throughout the day.
